payload.decision: Reject H028/T036 and close candidate-level summary, pointwise-loss, pairwise-ranking, and soft top-k selection over the T033 pair dictionary. Select H029/T037 as one materially independent bounded mechanism: full row-level candidate-conditioned emissions decoded by hard Viterbi on the exact deduplicated union graph of the 1,520 nonzero T033 pair paths plus zero fallback.
payload.rationale: T036 preserves the 4.628457 candidate oracle but reaches 12.472865 RMSE, retains only 0.983% of oracle gain, wins 0/5 maps and 7/25 cells, fails legacy and tail gates, and beats action priors by only 0.092333 RMSE. It compresses each complete candidate into 39 aggregate summaries before ranking, leaving the row/node emission field untested. The selected T036 output is soft in 23/25 contexts and fails genuine duplicate-action invariance; T037 does not repair T036 after scores, but structurally deduplicates complete paths before graph construction and uses hard decoding only.
payload.revisit_trigger: Do not reopen T036 families. Continue beyond T037 only if the full-emission decoder passes the frozen legal, transfer, tail, resource, and evidence-destruction gates; GO requires RMSE at most 8.0 and breakthrough at most 5.0.
payload.title: Replace candidate summaries with full-emission structured decoding
